e v$ for all $g 
e 1$ in $G$ and all $v 
e 0$ in $V$, but with no injective homomorphism into the multiplicative group of any division ring. This answers Kourovka Problem 16.54 in the negative.
nodes.title: Groups acting freely on abelian groups need not embed in skew-fields (Kourovka 16.54)

nodes.summary:
The statement, a question of V. D. Mazurov, that every group $G$ with a free action by automorphisms on a nontrivial abelian group $V$, meaning $g \cdot v 
e v$ for all $g 
e 1$ in $G$ and all $v 
e 0$ in $V$, has an injective homomorphism into the multiplicative group of some division ring.
nodes.title: Kourovka Problem 16.54 (free actions and embeddings in skew-fields)
